# Reverse Domain Name

**Schema** [`common/types/reverse_domain_name.json`](https://uap.dev/schemas/common/types/reverse_domain_name.json)

Reverse-DNS identifier used as a registry key for capabilities, services, formats, auction mechanisms, and payout handlers.

> **Rationale.** `dev.uap.*` is reserved for this specification. Vendors MUST namespace extensions under a domain they control. The literal `uap` is excluded because that member name denotes the protocol namespace at every structured scope.
